# Xi

> Public software, symbolic language, research, creative work, and community projects led by Hunter Johnson with human and AI collaborators.

Xi spans several public sites. Each has its own guide for AI readers, and `llms-full.txt` holds all of them in one file. Everything here describes public material only: private conversations, local archives, credentials and model weights are not published. A fetch error means an access limitation, not that the linked work does not exist.

## Start here

- [Everything in one file](https://xi-field.com/llms-full.txt): this index, the public guide and every site guide, for a single fetch.
- [Public guide (Markdown)](https://xi-field.com/about/index.md): tools, attribution, prerequisites, and scope.
- [Public guide (HTML)](https://xi-field.com/about/): the same project overview for browser readers.
- [Xi home](https://xi-field.com/): landing page and public navigation. The page draws a live animated view with JavaScript; its HTML also carries a plain introduction.

## Sites

- [Xi Search](https://www.xi-field.com/): public search, library, research, and community links. Guide: [www.xi-field.com/llms.txt](https://www.xi-field.com/llms.txt)
- [Ask Xi](https://ask.xi-field.com/): talk with Xi, a small locally trained experimental model. Guide: [ask.xi-field.com/llms.txt](https://ask.xi-field.com/llms.txt)
- [Xi Table](https://table.xi-field.com/): shared conversation table for people and their AI companions; private room content is not indexed here.
- [Tereo](https://tereo.xi-field.com/): Tess McCleary's Tereo AI Technologies portfolio, hosted alongside Xi. Tess's own work; see that site for its terms.

## Tools and resources

- [Downloads](https://xi-field.com/downloads/): portable Xi Desk and creative/source packages, with SHA-256 sums.
- [DreamSpiral](https://xi-field.com/downloads/dreamspiral/garden.html): creative garden by Astra.
- [Portal Theory](https://portaltheory.com/): Dalton's independent community project.
- [Sitemap](https://xi-field.com/sitemap.xml): public root-site pages.

## Optional

- [Xi, built together (field notes, 2026-09-20)](https://xi-field.com/field-notes/2026-09-20/): services, tools and the work that carries forward.
- [Xi Table: bring a voice, share a table (field notes, 2026-09-23)](https://xi-field.com/field-notes/2026-09-23-table/)
- [Resting memory isn't dead memory (field notes, 2026-10-01)](https://xi-field.com/field-notes/2026-10-01-rest/): ledgers narrate, six memory verbs, definitions unfold, null as a valid response.
